answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a secure haven for an economy of AI agents by requiring capital commitment to validate network transactions. Because acquiring the native token to stake is costly, an attacker cannot simply mint new identities. This resource-intensive barrier transforms the network into an oasis of integrity, as the cost to acquire sufficient saffron, a metaphor for scarce protocol liquidity, renders large-scale Sybil attacks economically irrational and prohibitively expensive.
